notes: Ad detection rules. Bundled with the extension and also fetched from GitHub so detection can be fixed without a store update. Bump 'version' on every change. A newer file replaces the bundled one completely, so keep every site's entries in it. adPings: requests that mark an ad's start; hosts must stay within that site's host permissions (sites.js). adMarkers: page elements that show while an ad plays ('playing': must be a playing video; 'timer': element showing the seconds left). Versions before 1.1.0 ignore 'site' and adMarkers.
